summary.text: Greg Ballard, a former Republican mayor of Indianapolis (2008–2016) and retired Marine Corps lieutenant colonel who ran under the Lincoln Party label, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Indiana Secretary of State to Beau Bayh.
He started the new party to run and said he was courting independent voters.

paragraphs.text: Ballard earned a bachelor's degree in economics from Indiana University Bloomington and a master's degree in military science from Marine Corps University.
He served in the Marine Corps from 1978 to 2001, fought in the Persian Gulf War, received the Legion of Merit and retired as a lieutenant colonel after 23 years.
Ballard was elected mayor of Indianapolis as a Republican and served two terms, from 2008 to 2016.
The Indiana Capital Chronicle describes him as a lifelong Republican.
In March 2026 he launched an independent campaign for secretary of state, using the label "Lincoln Party" on petition forms.
He argued that he was the most experienced candidate in the race, saying of his opponents: "They've never led anything of significance in their lives, and I have."
He received 3.6% of the vote to Beau Bayh's 51.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
